params.prompt_or_change: Output exactly these three sentences, one per line, with no other words, quotes or numbering: Take a slow breath. / Let your shoulders relax. / There is nothing you need to rush right now.

steps.why: voice.js reads each line as its own TTS call and joins them, so each sentence carries its own lead and tail silence: about 1 s of natural pause per sentence, with the words untouched.

params.extra: calm, warm, reassuring female voice; slow, unhurried, meditative pace, about 1.7 words a second; let each sentence settle before the next; speech only

steps.why: It speaks the exact words in one neutral synthetic voice, with no music or effects, at 0 credits. The slow-pace instruction plus per-sentence synthesis should land near 10 s. The harness fix would make that exact.

fix: voice.js: honour params.seconds. After synthesis, if the speech is shorter than 90% of the target, detect the pauses between sentences (silencedetect) and lengthen them evenly, capped at about 2 s each, with any remainder as a short tail, until the file is within ±5% of the target. If it is longer than 110%, re-synthesise with a faster-pace instruction or report it. Also derive the pace instruction from the words-per-second needed. Note: gpt-4o-mini-tts ignores the 'speed' parameter, so code must do the timing. Separately, the voice-gender regex matches 'other' as 'her' and 'manner' or 'human' as 'man'; match whole words.
